subject: Observability add-ons — tiering, credits, and packaging question
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@procureco.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:22:00Z
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention & tracing — packaging question

Hi Monica / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We like Redwood's core inference performance, and the ops visibility features are compelling for our compliance team. Before we move forward I need clarity on two things:

1) Retention tiers — the pricing sheet shows per-GB/month tiers but our storage pattern is spiky (month-end batches). Are there flexible crediting options or a burst bucket model?

2) Tracing SKU — can tracing be scoped to high-risk routes only (sampled) and priced accordingly? Our infra team only needs traces for a small subset (~8% of requests).

Also, if we commit to a 12-month reserved Dedicated instance with a modest commit, can we get observability add-ons discounted or credited against committed spend?

Attached our internal cost model and a short list of routes we want traced. Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Health

Attachments: Acme_trace_list.csv (csv), Acme_cost_model_q4.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention & tracing — packaging question

Hi Sofia — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers up front:

- Retention: we can present a hybrid model — base retention tiers for steady-state, plus a small burst bucket that covers spikes. The burst bucket is consumed first during spikes and replenishes monthly.
- Tracing: yes — sampling to a scoped percentage and route-filtering is supported; we can price quoted traces against sampled QPS rather than full QPS.
- Commit credit: we typically apply a percentage credit of committed Redwood spend to add-ons for 12+ month Dedicated contracts. The credit scale depends on commit size.

I'll pull together a clean SKU matrix and a worked example for your monthly profile. For transparency, can I share a draft pricing workbook and proposed credit schedule tomorrow? If that works, I'll loop in our pricing/finance contacts.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: —
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:12:00Z
Subject: FW: Observability add-ons: retention & tracing — packaging question

Aditya — forwarding Acme's asks (see Sofia below). Key points for approval:

- Their expected steady-state telemetry storage: ~1.2 TB/month, with spikes up to 3.5 TB at month-end. They want a hybrid model: base tier + burst credits.
- Tracing target: ~8% sampling of total requests (~300 qps sampled equivalent) limited to a set of high-risk routes.
- Commercial ask: If they sign a 12-month Dedicated commit (est. $45k/month), they'd like a 20% credit applied to observability add-ons or a one-time credits pool to offset month-end spikes.

My recommended response: offer the hybrid retention SKU with a 10% credits buffer on monthly billing + ability to purchase additional burst credits at a discounted rate; and price tracing at sampled qps with a negotiated 15% discount on add-on list price if they commit to $40k+/mo.

We need finance approval for the 15% concession and confirmation of whether a credits-pool approach (one-time prebuy) requires special billing terms. Also attaching a draft SKU workbook I intend to send them.

Request: Can you greenlight the 15% add-on discount for a $40k+/mo commit and signoff on a one-time prebuy credits option? If no, what's the lowest discount band you can approve without CRO sign-off?

Thanks,
Monica

Attachments: Acme_Observability_SKU_v3.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: FW: Observability add-ons: retention & tracing — packaging question

Monica — appreciate the context. Approve the 15% discount on add-ons contingent on:

- Commit threshold: signed 12-month Dedicated at >= $40k/mo (net of credits).
- Credits pool: allow a one-time prebuy of burst credits invoiced upfront and amortized monthly; offer a 10% off list on that prebuy only.
- Cap concessions: discount applies only to observability add-ons (retention, tracing, dashboards) and is not combinable with future promotional credits.

If legal/finance needs an L1 note, we can draft a one-paragraph commercial term. No CRO escalation needed.

Aditya
VP, Commercial Operations
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T18:44:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention & tracing — packaging question

Sofia — thanks for the patience. Based on internal approvals here's our proposal (summary):

• Retention: hybrid model — base tiers as per attached workbook plus a monthly burst credits pool. Your monthly steady-state (1.2 TB) would sit in base tiers; the pool covers spikes up to 3.5 TB.
• Credits pricing: one-time prebuy of burst credits invoiced upfront, amortized over the term. We'll give a 10% prebuy discount on the credits purchase.
• Tracing: scoped sampling for the high-risk routes you provided. We'll price traces against sampled qps.
• Commercial concession: 15% off observability add-ons if Acme signs a 12-month Dedicated commit >= $40k/mo (net). Discount is restricted to add-ons and not combinable with other promos.

I've attached the SKU workbook and a short sample math tab that applies your reported profile to the hybrid model. Next steps:

1) Review attached workbook and confirm the routes to be traced (we used the CSV you sent).
2) If ok, I can generate a formal addendum showing the 12-month commit terms, credits prebuy line, and the 15% add-on concession for signatures.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4382 — I'll add the draft addendum to the record.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow to finalize the commit language?

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_Pricing_20261129.pdf, Acme_Observability_SKU_v3.xlsx
